8,737 likes, 85 comments - passionpassport on April 18, 2022: "Intended to resemble a bright warm forest, Munich’s Municipal Law Library is one of the most beautiful in the world. The rather small library is located within the city’s new Town Hall, which was built between 1867 and 1908. ⁠
⁠
Pro trip from @themodernleper ⤵️⁠
Open to the public, be sure to visit early or join the tours through town hall. ⁠

#passionpassport #germany".
